pages.title: Lose weight without it becoming a second job
pages.lead: Log what you eat in a few taps, see how your days really add up, and get a daily target that moves with how active you are.
pages.who: Doris, 58, recently retired, wants to lose weight sensibly.
points: Pick meals from your own foods, or snap a photo or scan a label, instead of typing numbers.
Your daily target moves with your steps and exercise, so a busy day is not counted against you.
A plain weekly picture of what is working, with the evidence behind any suggestion labelled.

pages.title: Keep your carbs where you want them
pages.lead: A carb ceiling you choose, counted the way you choose (net, total or gross), with fibre, fasting and ketone notes alongside.
pages.who: Sam, 26, strict low-carb lifestyle, early days.
points: Set your own ceiling and see at a glance how today is going.
Foods come from barcodes, labels, photos and your own library, so you almost never type numbers.
Fasting windows and meal timing are worked out from the times on your meals.

pages.title: Type 2 diabetes: see what food and movement do
pages.lead: Carbs, weight, steps and your own readings side by side, so you and your care team can see the pattern.
pages.who: John, 47, type 2 diabetic, low activity, trying to lose weight.
points: Carbs, weight and activity on one screen, with your own targets.
Lab results and readings logged on the day they were taken.
Share a summary with your clinician or carer only if you choose to; nothing is shared by default.

pages.title: Build muscle: protein and training in one place
pages.lead: Protein targets that follow your training, a log you can fill in quickly, and trends that show whether it is working.
points: Protein and calorie targets that rise on training days.
Log a meal by choosing from your own foods, or by voice.
Weight, body composition and training trends side by side.

pages.title: Just see what you eat and how you move
pages.lead: No diet to follow and no goal to set up first. Start with a calm screen and add more only when you want it.
pages.who: Karen, 41, inconsistent eating and activity, wants a clearer picture.
points: Start with food, water, movement and sleep, and nothing else.
Hide anything you do not use; the screen stays how you leave it.
Ask the app a question about your own days when you are curious.
